title: Questions 176-180 refer to the following e-mail and notice.
passage_1:
To:Tomas Riveiro <t.riveiro@atelier-nord.com>
From:Isabel Duarte <i.duarte@larkspurandvane.com>
Date:4 September
Subject:Inquiry

Dear Mr. Riveiro,

I am writing to ask whether you would consider joining us as head of design at Larkspur & Vane. Our current chief designer, Margit Halloran, retires on 1 December, and she suggested that you would be an ideal candidate for our company.

Seeing your recent collection in person at the Northern Craft Selection convinced me of your outstanding talent. In particular, incorporating reused vintage fabrics into modern suits was an innovative method. This way of approaching sustainable fashion aligns perfectly with the new direction we hope to take our brand in.

We would very much like to talk this over with you. Please let me know whether you are free to meet next Thursday.

Sincerely,

Isabel Duarte
Founder, Larkspur & Vane

A Note to Our Clientele

Dear Valued Clientele,

We are pleased to share an important development at Larkspur & Vane. From next month, Tomas Riveiro will take over the role as head of design.

We appreciate that a rapid change may cause some concern, but you can be confident that the exceptional quality you have come to expect will remain unchanged. In order to properly give Mr. Riveiro a warm welcome, we will hold a reception on the evening of 12 December. Refreshments will be served, and Mr. Riveiro will be on hand to talk about our future direction in the fashion industry.

We look forward to meeting you there.
